tools.name: get_pricing_terms
tools.description: Read this first and relay it to the contractor before creating an account. Returns the plain-language pricing disclosure ($5 browsing lead, $15 high-intent lead, optional $150/month unlimited; nothing charged until the contractor unlocks a lead) and the guarantees. No inputs.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: Explains the two install paths (iframe embed on an existing site, or a GroundQuote-hosted page for contractors with no site), what works with AI site builders, and how account ownership works. Use before you promise the contractor anything about the install.

tools.name: create_contractor_account
tools.description: Creates a GroundQuote account for a fence contractor and emails the contractor a link to set their own password (the email includes the pricing terms). Nothing is charged; no card is required. Returns org_id, slug, the embed snippet, terms_summary, and a setup_claim you must keep and pass to set_fen

tools.name: set_fence_pricing
tools.description: Loads the contractor's price list. Rates are dollars per linear foot by material, then style, then height ("4 ft", "6 ft", "8 ft"). Gates are flat surcharges. Ask the contractor for real numbers; never invent them. Replaces the whole fence catalog each call. Requires org_id and setup_claim from crea

tools.name: set_branding
tools.description: Sets logo, colors and font on the quote widget. Pass auto_fetch_from_url to read the logo and primary color from the contractor's existing site; explicit fields win over fetched values. Requires org_id and setup_claim.

tools.name: set_hosted_page
tools.description: For contractors without a website: turns on a branded page at groundquote.com/{slug} with headline, services and contact details. Requires org_id and setup_claim.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Returns the iframe HTML to paste into the contractor's site and the hosted-page URL. Requires org_id and setup_claim.

tools.name: check_account_status
tools.description: Shows whether the contractor has set their password yet (setup_link_pending), the current pricing summary, branding and install details. Requires org_id and setup_claim.

tools.name: resend_setup_email
tools.description: Re-sends the contractor's set-password email (max 3 per day per account). Requires org_id and setup_claim.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches GroundQuote's documentation (what it is, pricing, install, ownership, pricing format, rules for assistants). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of a documentation entry by id from search.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_contractor_account" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_embed_code · Private data: create_contractor_account, set_hosted_page, check_account_status, resend_setup_email · Public sink: create_contractor_account, resend_setup_email · Destructive: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_embed_code · Private data: create_contractor_account, set_hosted_page, check_account_status, resend_setup_email · Public sink: create_contractor_account, resend_setup_email · Destructive: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
